title: Performance and style knowledge: compute Role Center headlines in the background; build client links with GetUrl
summary: Two new development guidelines added: computing Role Center headlines in background tasks via the RC Headlines Executor, and building client links using GetUrl instead of hardcoded URLs.
key_points: New performance article: loop-based Base App headlines should compute in an OnComputeHeadlines subscriber on codeunit 1441, with results stored per user
Own HeadlinePart pages have no executor event and should use a page background task
New style article: links into the running environment's client should come from GetUrl, not a hardcoded host, tenant or environment
Edge cases follow Learn: unpublished SOAP/OData objects raise a runtime error, and UseFilters can return an empty string
Both articles ship compiling good and bad samples and are wired into the performance and style review skills
